research_question: What does adding retrieved literature contribute to classification, explanation support, and cost when Qwen already receives historical cases?

D.name: Qwen with historical cases and literature

evaluation.notes: Build and validate C first using the portable validation evidence. The initial Colab smoke pilot runs three cases; the planned validation pilot contains ten. D remains a later extension requiring permitted, approved literature. The two-generations setting describes the eventual paired C/D study, not two repeated C generations. Generation budgets and final sample size must be frozen after paired validation and before test scoring.
